predecessors.name: Zhou dynasty
predecessors.text: Western Guo, 'in the Yellow River valley between Xi'an and Luoyang', capital Shangyang 'straddling both banks of the Yellow River' at Sanmenxia (list page: from north-eastern Pinglu County, Shanxi…

successors.name: Jin (Chinese state)
successors.text: Western Guo, 'in the Yellow River valley between Xi'an and Luoyang', capital Shangyang 'straddling both banks of the Yellow River' at Sanmenxia (list page: from north-eastern Pinglu County, Shanxi…

ledger.x: 1046: King Wu enfeoffs his uncle Guo Shu.
655: the state of Western Guo ends in Jin's conquest; 'The Guo leader Guo Gong Chou fled to the Zhou capital Luoyang'.

wars.name: Jin conquest of Guo and Yu
wars.outcome: Jin borrowed a road through Yu to destroy Western Guo in 655 BC and then conquered Yu (the 'borrowing a road to conquer Guo' stratagem).

certainty.note: No Guo boundary is on the page; the move east is undated.
